Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking the time to connect — our infra and platform leads (cc'd) would like a 45‑60 minute technical review to align on integration patterns, KV cache semantics, and expected tail-latency behaviour when we run longer prompt chains.

High-level asks:
- Walk us through routing and fallback (model variants, regions)
- Discuss KV cache invalidation and prefix-sharing implications
- Latency SLOs at 95/99 with sample traffic profiles

We are flexible next week; proposed windows (PT):
- Tue 2026-06-08 09:00–10:00
- Tue 2026-06-08 10:30–11:30
- Wed 2026-06-09 14:00–15:00

Can you confirm an agenda and any pre-read materials we should review? Also please share the meeting link (we use Google Meet) and any access steps for diagrams or docs.

Thanks,
Emily

Senior Platform Engineer, Acme Corporation
platform@acme.com

1) 5m — introductions & scope (owner: Soojin)
2) 15m — serving runtime overview & routing policies (Jonas)
3) 15m — KV cache semantics, prefix sharing, and invalidation strategies (Marissa)
4) 10m — sample performance profiles + cost/latency tradeoffs (Soojin)
5) 5m — action items / next steps / access requests

Pre-read / access:
- "redwood-arch-30m-agenda.pdf" (short agenda + slide plan) — Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_xxx/arch-review-packet
- "serving-constraints-summary.docx" — short explainer on latency SLOs and fallback behavior
- Miro board with system diagram + interaction flow: https://miro.com/app/board/uXjV_example

Attachments: redwood-arch-30m-agenda.pdf (agenda), serving-constraints-summary.docx (brief).

Access notes: if anyone on your side needs viewer access to the Drive/Miro, reply with the emails and I'll share; otherwise I'll add platform@acme.com. Also a small accessibility note: the live demo will reference an internal diagram (kv-cache-diagram.v1.png) — we can attach a static PNG to the packet if you want it ahead of time.

If the 10:30 slot looks good, I'll send the calendar invite (Google Meet) and add the packet links + attachments.

Best,
